properties.description: An iconic, globally available carbonated soft drink that stands as a flagship product of its parent corporation. With a history rooted in bold, refreshing cola flavors, the brand has maintained its position through heavy investment in music, sports, and entertainment partnerships. It serves as a mass-market staple appealing to a wide demographic looking for classic refreshment in casual and social settings. The brand continues to innovate with zero-sugar variants and modern packaging to remain relevant to contemporary consumer tastes.
properties.short_description: Pepsi is a global beverage brand known for its popular cola soft drinks and other flavored beverages.

short_descriptions.value: Une boisson gazeuse mondialement reconnue pour son goût audacieux, son caractère rafraîchissant et son intégration profonde dans la culture pop et le divertissement.
A globally recognized carbonated soft drink known for its bold taste, refreshing nature, and deep integration into pop culture and entertainment.
Un refresco carbonatado reconocido mundialmente por su sabor audaz, su naturaleza refrescante y su profunda integración en la cultura pop y el entretenimiento.
Ein weltweit bekanntes kohlensäurehaltiges Erfrischungsgetränk, das für seinen kräftigen Geschmack und seine tiefe Verwurzelung in der Popkultur bekannt ist.

properties.description: A world-renowned soft drink brand recognized for its signature cola flavor and iconic branding. As a flagship product of its parent company, it maintains a strong presence in global markets through massive marketing campaigns and sports sponsorships. The brand targets a wide demographic, focusing on youthful energy, fun, and modern pop culture. It continues to innovate its product range, including various zero-sugar and diet alternatives to meet changing consumer preferences.
properties.short_description: Pepsi Max is a sugar-free, maximum taste cola beverage available primarily in Asian, European, and Australia/New Zealand markets.

short_descriptions.value: Une marque de soda gazeux mondialement connue pour son goût audacieux et son ancrage profond dans la culture pop et la musique.
A globally recognized carbonated soft drink brand known for its bold flavor and deep roots in pop culture and music.
Una marca de refrescos carbonatados reconocida mundialmente por su sabor intenso y su profunda conexión con la cultura pop y la música.
Eine weltweit bekannte Marke für kohlensäurehaltige Erfrischungsgetränke, die für ihren kräftigen Geschmack und ihre Verbindung zur Popkultur und Musik steht.

properties.description: Pepsi Wild Cherry is a prominent flavor variant of the classic cola, celebrated for its sweet and crisp taste profile enhanced with bold cherry notes. It caters to a wide audience of soda lovers looking for a flavorful twist on a staple refreshment. As part of the extensive PepsiCo portfolio, it maintains broad distribution across retail and food service channels, securing its place as a go-to choice for casual consumption and social occasions.
properties.short_description: Pepsi Wild Cherry is a cherry-flavored variant of Pepsi cola known for its unique cherry flavor and sweet, crisp taste.

short_descriptions.value: A bold, fruit-forward twist on a classic cola, delivering a crisp and sweet cherry-infused refreshment.
Una audaz versión afrutada de un refresco clásico que ofrece un sabor refrescante, dulce y con un toque distintivo a cereza.
Une interprétation audacieuse et fruitée d'un cola classique, offrant une expérience rafraîchissante et sucrée au goût de cerise.
Eine gewagte, fruchtige Variante eines klassischen Colas, die für ihre knackige Süße und den unverwechselbaren Kirschgeschmack bekannt ist.
